items.question: At what stage should the image-fire-offering or the offering be presented during the vehicle procession?
premises: An image-fire-offering may be performed as a ritual action.
The conclusion of the vehicle procession provides an alternative occasion.
An offering is to be presented in this ritual sequence.
items.inference: Therefore, after performing the image-fire-offering, or at the end of the vehicle procession, one should present the offering.
uncertainties: Whether nayet governs mūrtihomaṃ directly or only baliṃ in the alternative construction is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Then, having performed the image-fire-offering, or at the end of the vehicle procession, one should present the offering.
